items.information: **Important Information for Participants:** **Location:** The competition will take place at the conference hall. **Arrival Time:** Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering:** All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants:** If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement:** First-time participants are required to bring an original, printed, or digital copy of their official ID card. Please ensure you have this with you.. **Cube Requirement:** Participants must bring their own cubes. Participants are responsible for the safety of the puzzles. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants:** If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit a copy of your Government-issued ID. We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. **On The Spot Registration** * On The Spot (OTS) Registration has been enabled for this competition if 50 competitors do not complete online registration. * All OTS Registrants have to come on time and follow the schedule * OTS Registrations are only available on day 2 of the competition * OTS Registration is only available from 8:00 AM to 8:30 AM * OTS Registration is only available for 3x3, 2x2 and 3x3 OH

items.name: Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026
items.information: Varmt välkomna till Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026! Sveriges sista tävling innan Europeiska Mästerskapet i Nederländerna! Första tävlingen någonsin som erbjuder övernattning i vindskydd! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026! Sweden's last competition before the European Championships in the Netherlands! First competition ever to offer overnight stays in outdoor wind shelters! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

Una vez alcanzado este límite los registros completos serán añadidos a la [lista de espera](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72865-lista-de-espera-waiting-list). #![Bandera GAL](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1NDY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1d55857fc84f004f1a94c2a3ddbc1ad3a591c62f/1F3F4-E0065-E0073-E0067-E0061-E007F_color.png) * Os socios da AES (Asociación Española de Speedcubing) recibirán un desconto do 15%. Podes facerte socio da AES aquí. * Os socios da AGS (Asociación Galega de Speedcubing) recibirán un desconto do 15%. Podes facerte socio da AGS de forma presencial no campionato. Para aplicar os descontos, o pago debe facerse igual que o resto dos competidores e, despois da competición, devolverase o importe correspondente aos descontos. Ao rexistrarte nesta competición aceptas que se che enviarán correos electrónicos informativos e que se che poderá solicitar confirmación de asistencia mediante correo electrónico. Se non se recibe esa confirmación, o teu rexistro pode ser anulado sen reembolso. Por favor, lede os correos que vos enviemos antes da competición, xa que poden conter información importante. Ademais, todos os competidores deben ler as lapelas de Información Importante e de Preguntas Máis Frecuentes (PMF) para o correcto desenvolvemento da competición. Un rexistro considérase completo unha vez realizado o pago correspondente. Os rexistros completos serán aceptados manualmente por orde de pago e aparecerán na lista de competidores ata acadar o límite establecido. Unha vez alcanzado este límite, os rexistros completos serán engadidos á lista de espera. #![Bandera UK](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0U5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a28e3c285bf55a2606838971abb0514d0ef172c/UK.png) * The AES members (Spanish Association) will receive a 15% discount. You can become a member of the AES [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/). * The AGS members (Galician Association) will receive a 15% discount. You can become a member of the [AGS](https://www.galiciaspeedcubing.org/) at the competition. For discounts, the payment must be made as all other competitors and after the competition the discounts will be returned. By registering to this competition you accept that informative emails will be sent to you and you might be asked for an attendance confirmation via email. **If said confirmation is not received, your registration may be deleted without refund.** Please, read the emails that we will send to you before the competitions since they may include **important** information. Moreover, all the competitors must read the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72861-informacion-importante-important-information) and Frequently Asked Questions ([FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72860-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) tabs for the correct development of the competition. A registration is considered completed once the fee has been paid. Completed registrations will be accepted manually in order of payment and they will appear on the competitors list until the competitor limit is reached. Once this limit is reached completed registrations will be added to the [waiting list](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72865-lista-de-espera-waiting-list). ​
